name: Fazier
conditions: Basic free tier requires a backlink to fazier.com on your homepage or footer.
Free listings are 'reviewed & listed within 30 days' — a month-long queue; homepage featuring only 'if selected'.
requirements: Product launches; daily launch board with leaderboard, reviews, and categories.
Sign In / Join present — account likely required for submission.
Free tier requires the backlink placed on homepage or footer.
preparation: Product name, URL, tagline, description, logo, category.
Backlink to fazier.com on homepage or footer for the free tier.

Plan choice: Basic free (backlink, ~30d review) / Lite $29 (publish now or schedule, no backlink, top-3 daily gets high-authority backlink) / Premium $49 (DR 83+ guaranteed dofollow, 15-day promotion, premium badge, PH launch checklist) / Super $99 (top-of-homepage placement).
workflow: Join/sign in at fazier.com, then open /submit.
Choose Basic (free with badge) or a paid tier.
Free: keep the backlink live; expect review/listing within 30 days.
Paid: publish immediately or schedule; Lite's backlink is conditional on Top-3 daily, Premium's is guaranteed.
watchFor: Lite tier's 'high-authority backlink' is Top-3-conditional — only Premium guarantees the DR 83+ dofollow.
Bundled 'Product Hunt Launch Checklist (value $39)' is an upsell sweetener.
Owner upsells a separate '100+ Directories Submission Service' (submitbro.com) — not required.
Help Center and Launch Guide are external Notion pages.
countsAsLive: A public product page on fazier.com/launches/<slug> (or product page) appearing in the daily launch list and leaderboard.
unknowns: Exact submit form fields behind sign-in.
Whether the free-tier backlink is re-verified after listing.
Whether the promotional prices are permanent.
